framework_detected: In medias res (8:57, Send hovering, model != deck) -> rewind '45 MINUTES EARLIER' -> PAS agitate loop x3. Opening executed fully; the agitate runs ~41 s (5-46 s) with three near-identical 'Done.' cycles, so Solve arrives late for a 122 s ad.
framework_recommended: In medias res + PAS (keep), but compress the agitate to two loops and land the reveal by ~32 s: B2B finance/consulting tools teach a pain, and the cold-open climax already supplies the stakes.

hook_alternatives.first_3s_visual: Real Changes panel landing 'All changes reviewed 10 of 10', red ring on 'Slide 4 title EUR71-73m -> EUR74.6m'
hook_alternatives.line: Last quarter, this slide went to the board wrong.
hook_alternatives.why: Opens on the real product proof and the exact number, so the 3-second viewer sees value before the story.

hook_alternatives.first_3s_visual: Giant chatbot '✓ Done.' card; it cracks to reveal the deck slide still reading EUR71-73m beside the model's EUR74.6m
hook_alternatives.line: 'Done' is the most expensive word in AI.
hook_alternatives.why: Challenges the category belief (chat answer = finished work) that the whole film argues against.

hook_alternatives.first_3s_visual: Big red 8:57 clock over three file cards (memo, model, deck), one number red in each
hook_alternatives.line: Three minutes. Three files. One number that has to match.
hook_alternatives.why: Turns the deadline into an explicit quest the viewer wants to see solved.
